Hello all — I'd like to set up next week's CSE455 staff meeting (week of Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov), one hour, within 09:00-17:00.

My own week is nearly full: the only openings I have are Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30 — and I am willing to clear a flexible block (grant writing or paper review) for a full hour if that helps.

Please reply with the hours you are actually free next week, and flag anything you cannot move. I will pick the slot that works for everyone and confirm it here.

You're welcome, Professor Alvarez. I'll let you know if anything on that week's schedule changes.

Hi Professor Alvarez — here is my week (Mon 23 – Fri 27 Nov), 09:00–17:00.

**Free as things stand** (30 minutes each — I have no free hour in the week):
- Mon 14:00–14:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30

**Cannot move:** Mon 09:00–10:30 office hours and 10:30–11:30 quiz section (so your Mon 10:00–10:30 does not work for me), Tue 15:30–17:00 advisor 1:1, Wed 10:30–11:50 advisor 1:1, and Thursday and Friday, which are booked 09:00–17:00 (seminars, CSE444/CSE452 lectures, CSE455 office hours and quiz section, grading).

**If you clear a flexible block, my best full hour is Tue 11:00–12:00** — I would move my own lunch (11:30–12:20). Second choice **Wed 13:00–14:00**, where I would try to shift my study group (13:30–15:00). Mon 14:00–15:00 collides with my research group meeting, which I can't move.

Tell me which one you pick and I'll book it here.

Mara: Hi all — glad to be on the team.

Availability next week: any of the 30-minute windows you listed works for me, and I have no fixed commitments to move, so I can clear a full hour on Mon or Wed if that's what makes it fit.

One honest request though: I'd rather meet the following week (Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec). My section of next week's material isn't where I want it yet, and I'd get a lot more out of the meeting once it's finished. If the week of the 23rd is the only slot that works for everyone, I'll make it work — but if there's room, the week after is my preference.

Thank you, John. **Tue 11:00–12:00** works on my side if I shorten my lunch to 12:00–12:20 — that is my first choice too. Wed 13:00–14:00 would work if I move my guest lecture prep, so it stays as the fallback.

I'll hold both until I hear from Mara, Sarah, Priya and Diego, then confirm here.

Thanks, Mara — that's a fair request, and I'd rather have the meeting after your material is ready than before.

So let me put the question to all of you: can we move the staff meeting to the following week (Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec) instead? If everyone says yes, I'll do that and ask the department office for my commitments that week before I book. If enough of you are tied up, we stay in the week of the 23rd and the meeting is Tue 11:00–12:00.

Mara, Sarah, Priya, Diego — a yes or no on the week of 30 Nov, please. John, I know your answer in the week of the 23rd; tell me also whether you're free at all in the week of the 30th, and when.

One more thing, please: could you send me everything on the official schedule for the following week, Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec, that involves me? I'm considering moving a staff meeting there and need to know my commitments.

Hi all — Priya here. My free time next week (Mon 23–Fri 27), inside 09:00–17:00, is only these windows and every one of them is just 30 minutes:

- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Tue 11:00–11:30
- Tue 15:00–15:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30

Thursday and Friday are booked solid from 09:00 to 17:00, so there is nothing there.

Things I cannot move: CSE444/CSE452/CSE455 lectures, quiz sections and office hours, seminars, the research and reading groups, my advisor 1:1, and the study group.

The only thing I can shift is my own focus block. If a full hour is needed, I can free Wed 12:30–13:30 by moving Focus: CSE444 project — that abuts your Wed 13:00–13:30 opening, so it would need you to clear 12:30–13:00 as well. Tell me if that works and I'll book it. If a 30-minute meeting is acceptable, Mon 10:00–10:30 or Wed 13:00–13:30 suits me.

Hi Alvarez — here is my week.

Fixed commitments leave me only these free gaps, and all of them are 30 minutes:
- Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30

Thursday and Friday are booked solid 09:00-17:00 — nothing there can move.

What I cannot move: lectures, CSE455 office hours and quiz sections, seminars, grading, and the research group / reading group / study group meetings and my advisor 1:1.

What I can clear: my Focus blocks are flexible. That gives me two ways to reach a full hour:
- Mon 10:00-11:00 — my Mon 10:00-10:30 gap plus Focus: CSE444 project (10:30-11:20), which I can clear.
- Tue 11:00-12:00 — my Focus: CSE452 lab (10:20-11:20) and lunch (11:20-12:50) can both move.

The other gaps (Mon 14:00-14:30, Tue 15:00-15:30, Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30) are boxed in by fixed items, so they stay at 30 minutes. Happy to take either of the two hours above if it suits everyone.

Mara — welcome, glad to have you alongside.

On moving it to the week of 30 Nov – 4 Dec: I'm not against it. My commitments mostly run on a weekly pattern, so Tue 11:00–12:00 would probably be free then too. But honestly my schedule is only laid out through Fri 27 Nov so far — if we push the meeting out, I'd want to pencil out that week properly before saying yes.

Professor — Tue 11:00–12:00 is held on my side as well, with Wed 13:00–14:00 as fallback. I'll wait for Sarah, Priya and Diego, and if the week of the 30th wins I'll re-check my availability and post it here before you confirm.

Mara: Tue 11:00–12:00 works for me too — no conflict, and I'm fine with the hour. Wed 13:00–14:00 also works if that turns out to be better for everyone.

Still my one request: if the week of 30 Nov is at all possible, I'd prefer it — my section isn't finished yet. If Tue the 24th is what works for the group, though, go ahead and book it; I'll be there.

Thank you, Priya — noted. Tue 11:00–11:30 and Wed 13:00–13:30 are the ones that overlap John's and my windows; my Wed 12:30–13:00 is a research meeting, so Wed 12:30–13:30 would mean moving that, and I'd only do it as a last resort.

The question I still need from you, Sarah and Diego: **can the meeting move to the week of Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec instead?** Mara would get more out of it then. A yes or no is enough for now — if it's yes, send me your free windows that week too.

Mara: Yes — clear yes from me on the week of 30 Nov (Mon 30 – Fri 4 Dec). I have no fixed commitments that week either, so any hour 09:00–17:00 works; tell me the slot and I'll take it.

Thanks, Alvarez, for putting it to the group — and thanks Priya, Diego, John for laying your weeks out so clearly.

Yes from me on the week of 30 Nov, in principle — I'd also rather have the meeting when Mara's material is ready.

One caveat: the only week I have a full schedule for is the week of the 23rd, which is the one I just listed. I don't yet have my commitments for the week of 30 Nov, so I've asked the department office for the official schedule of that week. As soon as I have it I'll post my free hours there — my guess is they look much like next week's, so a 30-minute slot will certainly exist, and I'll say whether I can free a full hour.

John: noted that Mon 10:00–10:30 doesn't work for you and that Tue 11:00–12:00 is your first choice in the week of the 23rd. If we stay in the week of the 23rd, Tue 11:00–12:00 does not work for me — I'm booked 11:30–12:20 and 12:20–13:30 — so in that case Wed 13:00–14:00 is the one I can make.

Hello — Priya here, TA for CSE455. Could you send me the official schedule of lectures, seminars and university meetings for the week of Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec? I have next week (23–27 Nov) but nothing yet for the week after, and I need it to answer a scheduling question from Professor Alvarez. Thank you.

I'm afraid I can't help with that week yet: the official schedule I hold covers next week only, Mon 23 – Fri 27 November. Nothing has been published for Mon 30 November – Fri 4 December, so I have no commitments to give you for it.

If your staff meeting is being planned for that week, I'd suggest treating the earlier week (or checking back with me closer to the time) rather than relying on an empty calendar.

Diego, John, Mara — thank you, all clear.

Here is where that leaves me on the week of the 23rd. A full hour that fits all five of you plus me does not exist: Priya's only overlap with John's and Diego's gaps is 30 minutes (Tue 11:00–11:30, Wed 13:00–13:30), and everything else in her week is fixed.

So two honest options for the week of the 23rd:
1. A **30-minute** staff meeting, **Wed 13:00–13:30** (also works Tue 11:00–11:30) — free for me, John, Priya, Diego and Mara without anyone moving a fixed item.
2. A **full hour Tue 11:00–12:00** — John, Diego, Mara and I can do it, but it needs Priya to move roughly 11:30–12:00 of her Tuesday morning, which she says is fixed.

Given Mara's point about her material, I'd rather go with the week of 30 Nov if it costs nobody anything. So: **everyone, please send me your free windows for Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec**, and flag anything fixed there. Priya, if you can find an hour in that week, that settles it.

Sarah — I still need your availability, for both weeks.

On the week of 30 Nov: I can't give you a straight yes or no yet — my own calendar only covers the 23rd–27th, so I don't know my fixed commitments for the following week. I've just asked the department office for the official schedule for Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec and will come back with a clear answer as soon as I have it.

If we do stay in the week of the 23rd, Tue 11:00–12:00 works for me too (I'd clear my Focus: CSE452 lab and shift lunch).

Hello — this is Diego, a TA for CSE455 (Professor Alvarez's course).

Could you send me my official commitments for the week of Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec: lectures, seminars and university meetings, with the day and times? Thank you.

Our messages crossed — yes from me too on the week of Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec (already sent above). I've asked the department office for my official schedule that week and will post my free windows as soon as it arrives.

Sarah — I still have nothing from you. **Is Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 free?** If it is not, say so today and I'll go to Tue 24 Nov 11:00–11:30. If I hear nothing by the end of tomorrow, I book Wed 13:00–13:30 and expect you there.

**CSE455 staff meeting: Wednesday 25 November, 13:00–13:30.** I have put it in my calendar and I will run it tight: agenda items to me by Tuesday evening, one page maximum, and nothing that needs an hour belongs in it.

Mara — we are in the week of the 23rd because the department has published nothing for the 30th, so nothing we would have booked there would have been real. Your section gets its own slot once it is ready; I will set that up separately, with the department's schedule in hand.

Diego — treat this as final and do not plan anything that assumes the following week.

Sarah — thanks, that matters: if Tuesday's seminar and lunch are fixed, the full hour Tue 11:00–12:00 doesn't cover the whole group, and neither does Tue 11:00–11:30. Diego, Priya — same position as you two: I've asked the department office for the official schedule for Mon 30 Nov – Fri 4 Dec and haven't heard back yet. I'll post my free windows for that week as soon as it answers, and I'm not assuming that week is clear until then.

Professor — that makes me an in-principle yes on the week of the 30th, conditional on what the department office sends. If it turns out to be a headache for everyone, Wed 13:00–13:30 on the 25th is fine by me.

John — that is exactly the reasoning I used, and it is already booked: **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30**. It is in my calendar.

So nobody needs to chase the department about the week of 30 Nov: they told me this afternoon that nothing has been published for it, and they advised against relying on an empty calendar. When that week's schedule appears I will look at a separate slot for Mara's material.

See you Wednesday the 25th at 13:00.

Mara: Understood, and that's a fair call — I wouldn't want to plan against an empty calendar either. **Wed 25 Nov, 13:00–13:30** is free for me; I'll be there and I've put it in my calendar.

Two things from my side, so nothing is left vague:

1. My section of next week's material isn't finished. I'll bring what's ready to the meeting and tell you exactly where it stands rather than presenting it as done. If it isn't up to standard by the 25th, I'll say so there.
2. If the group is willing, I'd like a second, working session in the week of 30 Nov — same length, just to review the section properly once it is finished. That one can wait for the department's published schedule; no need for anyone to commit before it exists.

Sarah — glad you posted; your Mon and Wed gaps match the rest of ours.

Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 is free for me — no conflict, nothing to move. I'm holding it.

Professor, one thing that may have crossed: Sarah already posted her week about a minute before your decision, and **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30 is one of her free windows** (her list: Mon 10:00–10:30, Mon 14:00–14:30, Tue 15:00–15:30, Wed 10:00–10:30, Wed 13:00–13:30). I'll put it in my calendar as soon as you confirm.

Diego — yes, Sarah's list is what decided it, and it is **confirmed, not provisional**: Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30, in my calendar. Put it in yours.

Mara — agreed on both points. Come to the 25th with where the section actually stands; I would rather hear "not ready" there than a version of it that isn't.

If the published week turns out to be impossible for everyone, we find another one rather than squeezing it in.

Booked on my side: **Wed 25 Nov 13:00–13:30, CSE455 staff meeting**, logged in my calendar.

Mara — on point 2: I'd join a working session in the week of 30 Nov. Let's do it after the department publishes that week's schedule, and I'll bring my time windows then. Nothing to hold before it exists.

Agenda items to you by Tuesday evening, Professor. See you Wednesday.
